λοξεύω.definition: = Lib.Descr.30.18; obscure or symbolical language, Syn.Alch.p.63 B

λοξόω.definition: make slanting, cast sideways, Sophr.49:— Pass., to be or become so, Hp.Mul.1.33, Eudox. ap. Arist.Metaph.1073b20, 29, Str.6.2.1

λοπάω.definition: let the bark peel off, of trees which; of fig-trees, rot at the root, Id.CP5.9.9

λοπητός.definition: the time of bark peeling off, Id.HP5.1.1

λοπίς.definition: iron pin to keep a in place, Aen.Tact.20.3; fragment of BCH29.541

λοπός.definition: of a hide, the outer part of a split piece of leather, opp. Hp.Art.33, cf. 38

λόρδων.definition: the demon of impure , cf. , Pl. Com.174.17

λούστης.definition: one fond of bathing, of certain birds, opp. Arist.HA633a29; M.Ant.1.16

λουτιάω.definition: Desiderat. of wish to bathe, Luc.Lex.2

λούτριον.definition: water that has been used in washing

λουτρίς.definition: woman employed to wash Athena's; bathing drawers, Theopomp.Com.37

λούω.definition: contr. from from which come impf; rarely of things, PFlor.384.30

λοφιά.definition: Ion. mane or bristly ridge; back-fin of dolphins and similar fishes, D.S.3.41, AP9.222 , Philostr.Im.1.19

λοφόομαι.definition: Pass., to be raised up, grow into a ridge or hill, Eust.ad D.P.638

λοχαγέω.definition: Dor. for lead a; consist of Ascl.Tact.10.13, 11.1

λοχάω.definition: Ep.aor. subj. Med. Od.4.670:—lie in; abs., lie in wait, ambush, Il.18.520; Hdt.4.22; E.El.225; Pherecr.141: but mostly in aor. part. with another Verb, . . Od.22.53; Hdt.6.87, cf. 37; . . Th.1.65, cf. 3.94:—Med., Od.4…

λυγίζω.definition: Dor. fut. inf. Theoc.1.97; throw, master, Theoc.l.c.:— Pass., to be thrown or mastered, Id.1.98; Id.23.54

λυγόω.definition: tie fast, AP9.150; bend, overpower, AP5.216

λύζω.definition: aor. Gal.15.846:—to have the hiccup; sob violently, from fear or cold, Arist.Pr.962b33; Ar.Ach.690; AP7.218.12

λυθρόω.definition: misspelling of redeem a pledge, CPR12.17

λύμη.definition: outrage, maltreatment, esp. by maiming; corruption, . . Plb.6.10.3

λύπη.definition: pain of body, opp. Id.Phlb.31c, etc

λυρίζω.definition: play the lyre, Chrysipp.Stoic.3.140; trans., play on the lyre, Phalar.Ep.67.1

λυσίκοπος.definition: freeing from fatigue, Poet.de herb.28 cod

λυσιτελής.definition: prop. paying for; rarely of persons, profitable, advantageous, Pl.Phdr.239c

λυσιτόκος.definition: loosing the pains of child-birth; Pass. set free by birth, i.e. eggs that have been laid, Opp.C.3.128

λύσσα.definition: Att. rage, fury, in Hom. always of; after Hom., raging madness, frenzy, such as was caused by the gods, as that of Io, A.Pr.883 ; of Orestes, Id.Ch.287, E.Or.254, etc.; of the Proetides, B.10.102; of Bacchic frenzy, E…

λυσσόω.definition: enrage, madden:—Pass., to be or grow furious, Ps.-Phoc.122

λυτήρ.definition: one who looses, deliverer; arbitrator, decider, Id.Th.940

λυχνεών.definition: place to keep lamps in, Luc.VH1.29

λυχνίς.definition: rose campion, Lychnis coronaria, used; corn cockle, Agrostemma Githago, ib.101, cf. Nic.Th.899

λυχνίτης.definition: a precious stone of a red; a name for Parian marble, which was quarried by lamp-light, Varro ap.Plin.HN36.14

λύω.definition: poet. imper. Pi.Fr.85: fut; of things, unbind, unfasten, esp. clothes and armour, Il.4.215, 16.804; loose the maiden-girdle, of the husband after marriage, Od.11.245; of the wife, Pi.I.8.48; E.Alc.177; so . . Id.Tr.50…

λωβάομαι.definition: Act. only Ps.Phoc.38, and in Plb.15.33.9: but pf. is used as Pass., mutilated, Hdt.3.155, Pl.Grg.511a, R.611b, etc.; esp. of leprous persons, Man. ap. J.Ap.1.28: also aor. Pass., Pl.Grg.473c: and Ion. pres. 3pl. in Hp…

λωβεύω.definition: mock, make a mock of, Od.23.15,26

λωβητής.definition: = foreg., one who disgraces his trade, Ar.Ra.93

λωποδυσία.definition: prop. slipping into another's clothes: hence, highway-robbery, J.BJ4.3.4 , Gloss

λωφάω.definition: rest, give over; c. gen. , take rest or abate from, recover from, A.Pr.378, 654; S.Aj.61; Pl.Phdr.251 c; Id.R.620c; so Th.6.12

λίμνηθεν.definition: Adv. from the lake or sea, A.R.4.1579

λίπα.definition: used by Hom. as Adv. usu. in the phrase; in Hp. sts. as Subst., neut. nom. or acc., Mul.2.133; ib.145; so D.C.53.27

λογάδην.definition: Adv., picked, of troops; mostly of stones for building, bringing the stones as they picked them out, Th.4.4, cf. 31, 6.66, D.H.Comp.22
